name: ntr_db_get_master_position_id
xsql:
select  pos.master_position_id from xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa inner join xactly.xc_position pos 
on ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
where ppa.participant_id in (select participant_id from xactly.xc_participant where employee_id in (select pa.employee_id as employee_id from xactly.xc_user usr
inner join xactly.xc_part_user_assignment pua 
on usr.user_id = pua.user_id 
and :v_qtr_start_date between pua.effective_start_date and pua.effective_end_date
inner join xactly.xc_participant pa 
on pa.participant_id = pua.participant_id
where usr.email = 'pgrinnell@natera.com'
and :v_qtr_start_date between pa.effective_start_date and pa.effective_end_date)
and is_master = 1)
and :v_qtr_start_date between pos.effective_start_date and pos.effective_end_date
